Name: Penny by Amahra Dracul
Author: AmahraDracul
Description:
[font=Arial][size=3]I have remade some parts of the mod because, unintentionally, I've stole somebody else's work, the original art is old and I didn't remember that I used somebody's else work. Since I feel very bad about it, I want to leave here my public apologies. I believe and hope everything is in order now with this rework. If so, enjoy this mod![/size]

    ====================================================================================================================﻿

﻿[size=5]What will change?
[/size]
[/font][font=Arial][list=1]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]Penny portraits and character sprites will get minor changes, her hair color is now strawberry blond and her eyes are green;[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]There are configurable options to choose her clothes between pink, blue and yellow;[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]There is also a configurable version to seasonal clothing. Fall and summer have two options to choose from;[/size][/font]
[*][size=3]Penny will change her clothing on the Flower Dance, Luau and Spirit's Eve.[/size]
[/list]
    ====================================================================================================================﻿

[size=5] ﻿How to Install:[/size]

[/font][list]
[*][font=Arial]Make sure to have the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher;[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Unzip the folder with 7zip, WinRAR or a similar software;[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Put the unzipped folder named "[CP] Penny by Amahra Dracul" in the Mods folder of your game files.[/font]
[/list][font=Arial]
[/font][font=Arial][size=3]   [/size][size=2] ============================================================================================================================﻿[/size]
[size=3]
﻿If you find any mistake left behind, please, let me know! I'll fix it as soon as I can.
﻿Suggestions and feedback are always welcome :)[/size]
[/font]
